id: 06_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Incident or Near Miss Scenario
title: 是事故还是未遂（国内版）
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/06_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Incident or Near Miss Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/06_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Incident or Near Miss Scenario（国内版）/src.py

points.K6: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在动物实验室门口，两手各举一张卡片：一张有对勾，一张有感叹号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at an animal facility door holding two blank cards, one with a check mark icon and one with an exclamation mark icon.
shots.narration: 这一课：是事故，还是未遂事件？

shots.scene: 小研穿防护服、戴口罩面屏和手套，在动物实验室里，旁边是一个简化的猴子图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a gown, mask, face shield and gloves stands in an animal room next to a simple cartoon monkey icon on a padded table.
shots.narration: 小研在动物实验室给实验猴做注射。

shots.scene: 注射器图标和针头图标分开，中间有断开符号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a syringe body separated from its needle, with a small break symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 注射后，针头和注射器脱开了。

shots.scene: 简化的猴子图标上插着一枚小针头，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A simple cartoon monkey icon with a tiny needle icon on its arm and a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 针头还留在动物的皮肤里。

shots.scene: 徒手捏起针头的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of bare fingers picking up a loose needle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 她用手把针头取了下来。

shots.scene: 注射器对准针头重新组装的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a syringe being pushed back onto a loose needle held in fingers, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 又想接回注射器，一起丢进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 手指图标上出现一个红点和警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A finger icon with a small red dot and a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 就在这时，针头扎进了手指。

shots.scene: 欣欣在两张卡片之间来回看，头顶一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks back and forth between two blank cards labeled only with icons, a question mark above its head.
shots.narration: 这算事故，还是未遂事件？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起带感叹号的卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the card with the exclamation mark icon.
shots.narration: 答案：已经扎伤，这是一起事故。

shots.scene: 左边：受伤的小人图标；右边：险些被砸到但没受伤的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: on the left a person pictogram with a bandage, on the right a person pictogram stepping back from a falling object, unhurt. No people.
shots.narration: 造成了伤害或暴露，就是事故。

shots.scene: 右边图标放大：物体落在身边，人完好
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the right icon: an object lands right next to an unhurt person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 差一点出事、但没有伤害，叫未遂。

shots.scene: 两种卡片都被放进同一个报告箱
shots.prompt_en: Both cards drop into the same blank report box. No people.
shots.narration: 两者都要报告，都要找原因。

shots.scene: 小研立即停下，在水槽边冲洗手指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student immediately stops and rinses her finger under running water at a sink.
shots.narration: 被扎后，立即挤出血液，流动水冲洗。

shots.scene: 消毒棉签和创可贴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an antiseptic swab and a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 冲洗后消毒，包扎伤口。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告，老周拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man, who immediately picks up a telephone.
shots.narration: 马上报告负责人，尽快就医评估。

shots.scene: 猴子图标旁加一个红色感叹号和医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple monkey icon with a red exclamation mark next to a hospital building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 动物来源的针刺，风险更特殊，不能拖。

shots.scene: 锐器盒放在操作台旁，伸手可及
shots.prompt_en: A yellow sharps container placed right next to the work table, within arm's reach. No people.
shots.narration: 锐器盒放在手边，用完立即投入。

shots.scene: 回套针帽、徒手拆针、重装针头三个图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: recapping a needle, removing a needle by hand, and reattaching a needle. No people.
shots.narration: 不回套针帽，不徒手拆装针头。

shots.scene: 镊子夹起一枚脱落的针头，放入锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers pick up a loose needle and drop it into a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 针头掉了，用镊子夹起放进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 一体式带锁口的注射器图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a syringe with a screw-lock needle connection and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 选用不易脱开的注射器和针头。

shots.scene: 老周和小研两人配合，动物图标被妥善保定
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student work together beside a simple monkey icon resting calmly in a padded restraint frame.
shots.narration: 动物要妥善保定，必要时两人配合。

shots.scene: 王老师给小研发放空白的培训合格证
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the female graduate student a blank training certificate.
shots.narration: 动物实验人员，须经培训合格上岗。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白登记表上记录，小研在旁说明
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator fills in a blank exposure record form while the female graduate student explains.
shots.narration: 暴露要登记：时间、经过、处置。

shots.scene: 日历图标上圈出几个复查日期，旁边是医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with several follow-up dates circled next to a hospital icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按医嘱随访复查，不能一扎了之。

shots.scene: 老周和组员围着空白白板，讨论改进办法
shots.prompt_en: The older man and team members gather around a blank whiteboard discussing improvements.
shots.narration: 全组复盘，改进操作和器材。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这门课不能代替本实验室的规程。
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现事故卡和未遂卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating cards with an exclamation mark icon and a check mark icon.
shots.narration: 有伤害是事故，没伤害是未遂。

shots.scene: 锐器盒和镊子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sharps container and tweezers. No people.
shots.narration: 针头不回套，不徒手，进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 水龙头、电话、日历三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a running faucet, a telephone, and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 扎伤先冲洗，再报告、就医、随访。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研在动物实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the female graduate student wave goodbye at the animal facility door.
shots.narration: 锐器无小事，下次见！
